title: Restriction comparison complex normalization
statement: For compatible coefficient families R,S and a change a:R→S [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data], let g:U→V. Let dc be the termwise ordinary restriction/direct-image comparison with the canonical composition identifications [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction], and dd its derived comparison. For every complex K over S_U, the R direct-image complex unit on the restriction of K, followed by the derived direct image of the inverse restriction factorization and dd inverse, equals q(dc inverse) followed by the inverse restriction factorization on the S direct image of K and restriction of the S direct-image complex unit. The derived and ordinary scalar restrictions are those of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower].

source.place: Tags 07A6 (lemma-adjoint), 0D6D (lemma-compose-pushforward), and the comparison argument of lemma-adjoints-push-pull-compatibility; sites-modules.tex lemma-adjoint-push-pull-modules.

proof.text: Take the defining complex-unit equation of the canonical derived restriction/direct-image comparison. Its ordinary comparison is exactly dc degreewise. Cancel the two exact restriction factorization isomorphisms with the elementary isomorphism-square identity. This gives the forward square with dd.hom. Apply the inverse-composition equivalences to dd and the localized dc to obtain the displayed inverse square. No resolution comparison or computation unit is inverted.

theorem scalarRestriction_complex_normalization
    {R S : Coefficients.{u}} (a : Change R S)
    {U V : Scheme.{u}} (g : U ⟶ V)
    (K : CochainComplex (pbcModules U (S.ring U)) ℤ) :
    (coefficientDirectComplexUnit (proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage g
      (R.ring V) (R.ring U) (R.pull g))).app
        (((pbcRestrict (a.map U)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K) ≫
      (proEtaleRingDerivedDirectImage g (R.ring V) (R.ring U) (R.pull g)).map
        ((pbcRestrict (a.map U)).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app K) ≫
      (proEtaleRingRestrictionDerivedDirectImage g
        (R.ring V) (S.ring V) (R.ring U) (S.ring U)
        (a.map V) (a.map U) (R.pull g) (S.pull g) (a.square g)).inv.app
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) =
    DerivedCategory.Q.map ((scalarRestrictionComplex a g).inv.app K) ≫
      (pbcRestrict (a.map V)).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app
        (((proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage g (S.ring V) (S.ring U)
          (S.pull g)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K) ≫
      (pbcDerivedRestrict (a.map V)).map
        ((coefficientDirectComplexUnit (proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage g
          (S.ring V) (S.ring U) (S.pull g))).app K)
